Debt fair value is estimated using a discount rate based on US Treasury redemption yields plus a credit spread derived from month-end differences in ICE BofA 3-5 Year Single-A (2.7% 2030 notes) and 5-10 Year Single-A (2.96% 2035 notes) indices, updated monthly and applied daily; calculations exclude treasury shares.
